messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: Elevated 502/504 rate observed on api-gateway (edge). Pager routed to @mike_oncall. Spike began ~21:12 UTC. Current error-rate 12% on /v1/infer. Dashboard: https://infra.redwood/dashboards/edge-502s

mike_oncall: on it, joining. pulling gateway logs and kube events

mike_oncall: quick check — no deploys in last hour from deploy-bot, so likely infra/backends

ben_infra: seeing `connect reset by peer` in edge->eu-inference connections. A subset of backends (10.0.15.*) returning immediate resets. Latency to that pool increased before errors

alyssa_reliability: could be upstream overload or a recent model binary change on that pool. Any churn on eu-inference nodes?

nav_ops: autoscaler shows rapid restart churn on eu-inference-pool-7 around 21:11. I'm scaling an extra 3 nodes now and nudging keepalive to 90s for the pool

mike_oncall: running `curl -v` against mux endpoints — 502s reproduce against mux instance e-12, and proxy logs show upstream EOF

mike_oncall: mitigation plan: enable circuit-breaker on route `/v1/infer` -> fallback to infer-fallback pool; kick short traffic shift to regional fallback, and hold back routing to affected backends

ben_infra: applying CB rule now via envoy controlplane -> `cb: max_ejection_percent=40, base_ejection_time=60s`

emma_csm: flagging top-tier customers in case of user-facing errors. ETA for public note? small window but I'll send a brief heads-up to affected customers now

incident-bot: Incident updated: severity -> Sev2. Runbook: https://playbooks.redwood/edge-502-triage. Pager: on-call notified.

mike_oncall: traffic-shifted 20% to infer-fallback pool. error-rate dropped from 12% -> 3% within 60s. continuing gradual reroute and monitoring for 5m

alyssa_reliability: capturing logs and saving snapshot. initial hypothesis: upstream worker OOM/crash loop introduced after the last quantized-model rollout to eu pool. Scheduling an immediate rollback candidate check with model-ops

nav_ops: new nodes are up and passing health checks, but many older backends still showing `RST` counters. I'm removing the worst offenders from the LB until they recycle

mike_oncall: mitigation holding. I'll hand off to @alyssa_reliability for postmortem and followups. tagging for full postmortem: infra, eng-runtime, eng-ml, support

alyssa_reliability: acknowledged. I'll take it from here, collecting logs, correlation trace IDs, and customer impact window. thanks team :thumbsup:
